bio: Research Overview Research Background Education Publications Contact Us Dr. Holm’s research focuses on the ELSI issue in genomics research in a pediatric setting. She was PI of two NIH-funded grants, one as part of the NHGRI CSER (Clinical Sequencing Exploratory Research) consortium, to study the impact of returning genomic research results to parents and children. Dr. Holm’s related research focus is on diagnosing rare genetic diseases.
research_interests: a large international study of SIDS and leads the genetic studies.
